parole.significato: aul (a type of village in the Caucasus or Central Asia)
parole.testo: From West (Kypchak) Turkic awul, awïl; related to Ottoman Turkish آغل (“penfold”). Compare Karachay-Balkar ауул (awul), Bashkir ауыл (awıl), Kazakh ауыл (awıl) and Turkish ağıl.
Borrowed from a Turkic source (perhaps Ottoman Turkish باشمق (başmak)), from Proto-Turkic *baĺmak (“boot, shoe”). Compare Tatar башмак (başmaq, “shoe”), dialectal Turkish başmak (“shoe”).
